question: On PEE's own pages, which algorithm family links a value to the statement that establishes where it comes from (the publisher's method or test, a manufacturer declaration, a calculation) across sentences, tables and sections, and so decides its evidence role with provenance; and do the non-generative R3 mechanisms (semantic-type gating, PPMI distributional proposals, document concepts) let the learning mechanism acquire concepts that improve attribution and carry to a never-taught category?

served.domain_generalization: the check uses never-seen publishers and a never-taught category
served.ontology_learning_kg_induction: arm family E: concepts and typed relations induced from documents, validated against the definitions
served.continual_learning: every arm is also scored on the spent S89-S91 sets for property attribution and role: capability lost is reported, not only capability gained
served.transfer_learning: the document-relation mechanism is category-independent; its transfer is measured on the never-taught category

findings: The definition interpreter reads Step 1D-A2 structure but never consults the 1G table interpreter, whose contextLinks/classify already link method statements to result tables (reuse gap).

Of 134 reference measured values, 32 are table cells (1G: 10 publisher_measured via a linked method statement, 13 derived_or_estimated, 3 disputed, 4 manufacturer_declared, 2 unknown) and 102 are prose or label lines that no document link reaches.
1G calls measured inputs 'derived' when a calculation statement shares their section (power draw beside a running-cost estimate): input and output of a calculation are not told apart.
1G links a method statement only in the same section: a parallel results table in a sibling section inherits nothing.
In prose the statement establishing a measurement is usually a neighbouring sentence of the same paragraph (cross-sentence co-occurrence).

role.A0: S90 role model (roleModel 's90'), code at 843927c: reference
role.A1: S91 positive-evidence model, code at 843927c: reference
role.B: explicit document link reusing 1G: the 1G evidence class and its method links (ContextLink1G) are consulted for table-cell values, as structure-level evidence of the positive-evidence model
role.C: evidence selection over the document (EIDER / SciREX / DocRED, S87c C §6.2): statements are typed with the existing cue sets (method or test, declaration, calculation, quotation); a value is linked to a statement by three general relations: co-occurrence (same sentence, then neighbouring sentences of the same block), bridge (the statement names the value's property or quantity kind, from the definitions and QK, or an instrument of that kind, within the same or an ancestor section or a methodology section), and structural parallel (a sibling table or block with the same header signature inherits the links of its twin). The nearest link decides (minimal span); a tie of opposite roles at the same distance abstains; a calculation output takes the provenance of its inputs. Every decision carries its evidence pointer and fill type
role.D: label model (Snorkel family, S87c D §1.4): the signals of A0, A1, B and the three C relations as labelling functions; accuracies estimated without gold by the FlyingSquid triplet method on the unlabelled development items, weighted vote, a selective-abstention margin fixed on development
role.lightweightModel: a lightweight joint HTML and text model is run only if B-D are insufficient; not run in S92 unless recorded by an amendment

learning.E0: S90 learning mechanism (lexical n-grams, uncertainty states), unchanged
learning.E1: E0 + semantic-type gating (denotationOf / alignWithType, R3 dn.1) informed by the definitions: a term whose denotation is a condition, a claim or a source never becomes a property's surface term
learning.E2: E1 + PPMI distributional proposals (trainDistributional, R3 option 1) over the learning text: candidate terms near a property's terms, admitted only through the existing purity and specificity checks
learning.E3: E2 + document concepts / knowledge-graph induction (documentConcepts, R3 option 3b): recurring unaligned noun phrases next to values of one quantity kind become proposed concepts with typed relations to existing properties (same kind: related; object nouns), never used for attribution until verified

material.development: spent S89, S90, S91 check sets (375 values with a reference role, 951 values in all); runs on them are TUNED
material.check: a new wave fetched under the standing internal research policy: publishers never used by PEE; one category with definitions and one never taught (no definitions profile, no owner package); pages rich in original measurements and specification pages; page list recorded by amendment before any fetch

reference: blind Claude-agent annotation of each value with the page's line-numbered visible text: property (or none), role (S86b protocol), subject, the line of the statement establishing how the value was obtained (or none), and for values outside the definitions a short concept name; sealed by hash before any arm runs
metrics: per role: reference, predicted, correct, precision, coverage, recall, abstentions; beside the trivial baselines
linked method: for values the reference ties to a statement, whether the arm's evidence pointer reaches that statement (same line or block)
provenance: share of decisions carrying an evidence pointer, by fill type
errors introduced and results lost against A0 and A1
property attribution (correct, wrong, abstained, false) for continual-learning regression; conditions

learning: learned terms and proposals per arm; attribution on the check with each learned layer; induced concepts on the never-taught category: coverage of reference out-of-definition values and pairwise agreement with the reference concept names
all by category and by publisher group
